incident-bot: 🚨 PAGING: on-call eng-oncall. Alert INC-20260315-1 — elevated 5xx rate on /v1/infer from canary cluster. Error signature: KMS_DECRYPT_ERROR / missing env KMS_KEY_ALIAS. Affected: canary only (~12% traffic). Paging sara_ops.

sara_ops: on it. seeing 500 spike on canary graphs. linking traces. any recent deploys?

jen_release: yep, just rolled canary 2026.03.15-rc3 ~ 15m ago. Pipeline shows helm values changed for infer service.

miguel_sre: logs from pod infer-canary-5f6d: 
```
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z ERROR inference: failed to decrypt model key: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:...
stack: runtime/serve.go:142
```

raj_support: customers reporting timeouts when models call secure-store. Ticket count small but increasing. Customer-impact: some inference requests fail with 500, retries spike.

sam_security: quick check: did IAM role / service account change? I don't see role update in audit in last 24h.

jen_release: helm diff shows a conditional removing env var KMS_KEY_ALIAS from the canary values: `env.KMS_KEY_ALIAS: {{ .Values.kms.alias | default "" }}` and in CI we accidentally set `kms.alias: null` for canary due to a matrix bug.

sara_ops: ok mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag to stop canary traffic to code path that needs KMS 2) redeploy canary with correct env 3) if not stable, rollback canary. Who can flip flag now?

jen_release: I can flip. Which flag key? `infer.v2.encryption_enabled`.

jen_release: flipping flag to false (kill-switch) now.

incident-bot: Action logged: feature_flag_toggle by jen_release at 2026-03-15T14:18:12Z.

sara_ops: monitoring error rate after kill-switch... 

miguel_sre: error rate from canary drops ~90% in 45s. Latency back to baseline for most traffic. Jobs retry queue still has backlog.

raj_support: triage note to CS: tell affected customers we mitigated and working on root cause. No evidence of data exfil.

sam_security: confirm no KMS keys rotated recently. Rotation logs show last rotation 13 days ago — unrelated.

jen_release: applying quick fix to canary values now: setting `kms.alias: "alias/redwood-infer-canary"` and re-running helm upgrade.

deploy-bot: deploy started: helm upgrade infer-canary rc3 -> rc3.1 (user: jen_release)

miguel_sre: rolling pods; checking env on new pod: 
```
kubectl -n inference exec infer-canary-8b9c -- printenv | grep KMS
KMS_KEY_ALIAS=alias/redwood-infer-canary
```

raj_support: support note: retrying failed requests for affected customers backfilled, percent success ~98% after redeploy.

sara_ops: good. next steps: 1) re-enable feature flag only after smoke tests pass 2) patch pipeline to prevent null kms.alias 3) add preflight check in release job that validates required envs present for all rollout targets 4) postmortem. Anyone want to be incident lead for the writeup?

jen_release: I'll own the postmortem + patching release pipeline.

sam_security: I'll help with IAM verification and add a linter rule to flag empty KMS aliases in manifests.

miguel_sre: handoff — I need to step out in 20m. Taking notes: root cause = CI matrix produced null helm value for canary which removed KMS env; that triggered KMS Decrypt AccessDenied at runtime because code expects env and falls back to attempting decryption with an empty alias -> error. Mitigation = feature flag kill-switch + helm fix and redeploy. Follow-ups: add CI assertion, runbook update for canary env checks, add automated smoke test to detect KMS errors during canary.

raj_support: customer impact summary for postmortem: ~7 customers experienced transient failures, SLA impact minimal (window ~12m, error rate peaked 35% of canary traffic), no PII or model weight exposure.

incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-20260315-1 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned owners: jen_release (postmortem), sam_security (IAM review), miguel_sre (smoke tests), sara_ops (runbook updates).

miguel_sre: I'm handing off to sara_ops for final watch. Sara, please escalate if rate doesn't normalize in next 30m.

sara_ops: taking it. will monitor dashboards and coordinate with CS. closing active paging window unless new alerts. :thumbsup:

jen_release: follow-up PRs: 1) fix helm default values 2) add ci check for nulls 3) update release docs. PRs will link to INC-20260315-1.

raj_support: leaving a summary in #customer-facing-incidents for CS to reference.

sara_ops: final note: no rollback required. Can confirm canary stable at 14:50 UTC. Marking last_message_ts 1765013600.

miguel_sre: thanks all. good catch on the env default edge case.
